description: Authored demo transcript for the QR tap-to-teach page on AHU-23-01 (Harbourfront One). Written for the offline demo: no audio was recorded and no recogniser produced it. Its recorded_extraction is used only when live drafting is unavailable and the note is exactly this transcript.
transcript: AHU-23-01 condensate tray overflows when the drain trap dries out, usually after the coil wash. Before you restart the fan, pour about 2 litres into the trap and wait 15 minutes. If water reached DB-23A, keep it isolated and call the duty LEW, don't reset the breaker yourself.

rule_candidates.title: Prime the AHU drain trap before restarting the fan after a coil wash
rule_candidates.decision: Pour about 2 litres into the drain trap and wait 15 minutes before restarting the AHU fan.
forbidden_actions: Restarting the fan with a dry trap

rule_candidates.title: Condensate reached a distribution board: keep it isolated and call the duty LEW
rule_candidates.decision: Keep the distribution board isolated and call the duty LEW. Do not reset the breaker yourself.
forbidden_actions: Resetting the breaker without LEW sign-off
